shots.alt: Cargo screen showing the ship card, station travel card, station exchange card, and info card
shots.label: Layout
shots.title: Cargo bridge layout
shots.text: The selected ship sits above the station exchange and info card, with travel controls on the right.

shots.alt: Save game modal showing save slots, save actions, and developer controls
shots.label: Menu
shots.title: Game menu and save controls
shots.text: The menu exposes save slots, save now, new game, and developer-only controls when dev mode is enabled.

shots.alt: Top controls showing main tabs, tick speed, selected ship, music, and save buttons
shots.label: Controls
shots.title: Navigation, speed, ship picker, and tools
shots.text: The top bar selects the main tab, controls time, changes ships, and opens music or save tools.

shots.alt: Ship card status strip showing fuel percentage and hull damage percentage
shots.label: Status
shots.title: Fuel and hull damage actions
shots.text: The top strip of the ship card doubles as status readout and dockside action surface.

shots.alt: Ship cargo tab showing a loaded good with quantity, profit and loss, and sell controls
shots.label: Cargo
shots.title: Cargo lots and sell actions
shots.text: Cargo rows show quantity, route-aware profit and loss, and a manual sell action when docked.

shots.alt: Ship upgrades tab showing module slots and installed upgrades
shots.label: Ship modules
shots.title: Installed upgrade slots
shots.text: The ship upgrades tab separates installed modules from upgrade cargo waiting to be installed or sold.

shots.alt: Ship crew tab showing pilot, navigator, mechanic, and mercenary crew cards
shots.label: Crew
shots.title: Crew stations on the ship
shots.text: Pilot, navigator, mechanic, and mercenary roles live on the ship and unlock automation, guidance, upkeep, and combat support.

shots.alt: Stations travel card showing reachable destinations, fuel needs, travel time, and depart buttons
shots.label: Travel
shots.title: Reachable stations and departure checks
shots.text: Each route row shows destination, distance, fuel needed, travel time, local notes, and the depart action.

shots.alt: Station exchange Markets tab showing goods, stock, held quantity, price, net sell value, and buy controls
shots.label: Market
shots.title: Station goods market
shots.text: Markets list local commodity stock, held cargo, buy price, net sell value after tax, and buy controls.

shots.alt: Station exchange Upgrades tab showing upgrade modules for sale with prices and buy buttons
shots.label: Modules
shots.title: Station upgrade stock
shots.text: Buying from this subtab puts the module into cargo. Installing still happens from the ship card.

shots.alt: Station exchange Offers tab showing local crew hire cards and hire buttons
shots.label: Crew board
shots.title: Local hire offers
shots.text: Crew offers show role, name, tier, modifiers, cost, wage context, and a hire action.

shots.alt: Station exchange Contracts tab showing available work with tier, route, reward, penalty, expiry, and accept controls
shots.label: Contracts
shots.title: Station contract board
shots.text: Contracts show tier, requested good, destination, held amount, reward, penalty, expiry, and accept controls.

shots.alt: Info card showing default ship statistics, systems, service debt, and crew wages
shots.label: Info
shots.title: Default ship info
shots.text: The default info card summarizes wallet, cargo, fuel, hull damage, speed, systems, and upkeep.

shots.alt: Info card showing station details, profile, station flow, market pressure, and nearby routes
shots.label: Station
shots.title: Pinned station context
shots.text: Clicking a station row turns the info card into station context with tags, traffic, market pressure, and nearby routes.

shots.alt: Info card showing a trade helper for a selected commodity with market signals and route profit
shots.label: Helper
shots.title: Route-aware trade helper
shots.text: Clicking a good opens the trade helper with stock, prices, max buy, demand, route profit, flow, and related contracts.

shots.alt: Cargo station exchange showing suggested actions and highlighted guidance markers
shots.label: Guidance
shots.title: Navigator suggestion highlights
shots.text: With a navigator hired, suggested tabs and action buttons receive route-aware guidance markers.

shots.alt: Top controls showing the selected ship and manual versus auto pilot mode buttons
shots.label: Automation
shots.title: Manual and Auto pilot modes
shots.text: Auto mode is per ship. It becomes available once a pilot is hired and moves dockside actions under crew control.
